remarks: Travel down a grand boulevard to a winding freshly resealed driveway & behold your own piece of paradise! Encapsulated on a full acre, setting torn from pages of Architectural Digest while being strategically located minutes from every amenity! Impossible to duplicate enviable open concept home touched by tradition. Mature landscaping borders walkway to relaxing front porch. Entry door is side lit expanding the entrance. Step into your CT foyer w/2 coat closets. Split entry boasts home office. Inviting LR w/picture window. Hospitality abounds from formal DR w/grand picture window observing impressive backyard. Brilliantly lit airy kitchen glistens w/quartz counters, newer sink & garbage disposal. Kit Appl are excl incl DW. Sunlit sliding glass door brightens the area & opens to soaring 2 story sunken FR w/focal brick wall flanked by floor to ceiling windows.! Imagine brilliance from 4 skylights & huge picture window all observing your beautiful backyard. Substantial laundry rm w/cabinetry & shelving incl: washer & dryer. Ascend to 2nd floor by unique split stairway. Impossible: there are 4 bdrms w/walk in closets cooled by ceilings fans. Main bath brags "come relax" in jacuzzi tub. Walk in shower & solid surface vanity are highlights. Sumptuous & dramatic describes cathedral ceilinged primary bdrm w/2 walk in closets. View ensuite opulent bath. Charming Juliet balcony & loft area. Finished room 24x12 in basement to 2nd set of stairs to outside. Whole house generator for worry free living. Hollywood style backyard retreat for staycation envy. Behold brilliant blue 24x40 in-ground pool w/ new liner! Year-round enjoyment in large hot tub. Sunshade under pavilion area with stunning 2 colored aggregate patio. Expansive gated iron fence encloses this parklike yard. Towering treed land in rear offers seclusion!  Koi pond enhanced by perennials.  2 car garage & 2 car det. garage w/openers for hobbyists totals 4 car desirability! This Panache filled lifestyle fulfills the impossible dream! Most windows replaced w/Anderson 2 yrs ago. Showings begin Sat 10/17 @1pm. Offers due Sunday 10/25 @noon.
